name: es20-blending
title: Blending
summary: All 15 blend factors, FUNC_ADD/SUBTRACT/REVERSE_SUBTRACT and MIN/MAX, separate RGB/alpha factors and equations, the constant blend color and painter's-order alpha compositing, checked pixel by pixel against a CPU model of ES 3.0 4.1.7.
spec: ES 3.0 §4.1.7 Blending (§4.1.7.1 Blend Equation + Table 4.1, §4.1.7.2 Blend Functions + Table 4.2, §4.1.7.3 Blend Color, §4.1.7.4 Blending State)
ES 3.0 §4.1.8 sRGB Conversion (clamping and conversion of the blended result to fixed point)
ES 3.0 §6.1.1 Simple Queries (state table: blending state)
GLSL ES 3.00 §4.3.5 Uniform Variables, §4.3.6 Output Variables, §4.3.8 Layout Qualifiers, §4.5.4 Default Precision Qualifiers
GLSL ES 3.00 §6.4 Jumps (discard), §7.1 Vertex Shader Special Variables (gl_VertexID)

api.glEnable: BLEND (and glIsEnabled TRUE); blended draws match the CPU model only while enabled
api.glDisable: BLEND (control cells and destination pre-draws are exact, glIsEnabled FALSE); DITHER (glIsEnabled FALSE)
api.glIsEnabled: BLEND false initially / true after glEnable / false after glDisable; DITHER true initially, false after glDisable
api.glBlendFunc: 30+ cells: every source factor with ZERO and every destination factor with ZERO source; RGB and alpha results match Tables 4.1/4.2 within +-2/255; BLEND_SRC/DST_RGB/ALPHA read back (all four set to the same pair)
api.glBlendFuncSeparate: 4 cells with four independent factors match the CPU model; composite scene uses (SRC_ALPHA, ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA, ONE, ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA); four distinct values read back with glGetIntegerv
api.glBlendEquation: FUNC_ADD/FUNC_SUBTRACT/FUNC_REVERSE_SUBTRACT/MIN/MAX cells match the CPU model (MIN/MAX with ZERO and ONE factors prove the factors are ignored); both equation queries read back
api.glBlendEquationSeparate: 4 cells with different RGB and alpha equations match the CPU model; BLEND_EQUATION_RGB and _ALPHA read back (REVERSE_SUBTRACT/MAX and MIN/FUNC_ADD)
api.glBlendColor: CONSTANT_COLOR/ALPHA factor cells, a 12-step alpha ramp and an out-of-range color (clamped to [0,1]) match the CPU model; in-range color read back with glGetFloatv
api.glGetIntegerv: BLEND_SRC_RGB, BLEND_DST_RGB, BLEND_SRC_ALPHA, BLEND_DST_ALPHA, BLEND_EQUATION_RGB, BLEND_EQUATION_ALPHA initial and updated values; RED/GREEN/BLUE/ALPHA_BITS
api.glReadPixels: RGBA/UNSIGNED_BYTE blocks of every cell and probe pixels of the composite scene compared with the CPU model
api.glClear: COLOR_BUFFER_BIT; pixels outside every drawn rectangle (margins, gutters) keep the clear color
api.glViewport: full-surface viewport maps the NDC rectangles to the probed pixel blocks
api.glGetUniformLocation: u_rect, u_color, u_disc located; rectangles and colors observed in the image
api.glUseProgram: the rect/color program renders every cell
api.glUniform4f: u_rect places each rectangle in NDC, u_color is the source color; both verified by pixel position and value
api.glUniform1i: u_disc selects disc (discard outside) or rectangle; composite probes inside/outside discs
api.glDrawArrays: TRIANGLE_STRIP, 4 vertices from gl_VertexID, no vertex attributes; one draw per cell rectangle, checker square and disc

visual_review.notes: 256x256 radeonsi es-max capture viewed (the llvmpipe capture differs by at most 1/255 per channel). Top: 16x4 contact sheet of framed cells (blue frame = destination, inner square = blended result) on a dark background; rows 0 and 1 show a varied palette of orange, brown, green and blue tints, row 2 has green-framed equation cells (a pale cream saturated-ADD cell, MIN and MAX pairs identical to each other), row 3 ends in a smooth 12-step blue-to-orange cross-fade ramp. Cell 0 (ZERO, ZERO) looks white because its alpha is 0 and the viewer composites over white. Bottom: grey checkerboard visible through three translucent discs in two Venn clusters; the left cluster (drawn red, green, blue) and the right cluster (drawn blue, green, red) have visibly different overlap colors; disc edges are clean with no stray fragments.
